headline: OpenAI reports a candidate lattice definition of the Standard Model developed with GPT-6 Astra
summary: A Nov 15 OpenAI science post describes a candidate nonperturbative lattice definition of the Standard Model, linking an Oct 6 preprint by Nathaniel Craig. The paper proposes a gauge-invariant fermion measure for overlap fermions on finite four-dimensional lattices under an admissibility bound. Its author reports a Lean formalization whose proof terms compiled and passed separate kernel replay and axiom checks. OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra materially contributed to the refinement strategy and detailed proof, with outside lattice theorists reviewing drafts. This remains an author-reported mathematical construction: finite-spacing reflection positivity, efficient evaluation of the complete current, and an interacting continuum limit are open; practical lattice simulations are not yet established.
